title: Sanyu Wants to Be Like Mercy
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu watches her sister and wants to copy her exactly. But Mercy teaches her that true growth is not imitation—it's transformation.
keywords: growth, womanhood, transformation, sisters, Uganda, girls, virtue, character
dedication: For every girl learning to become who God made her to be.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu loves her big sister and wants to be just like her. But can she learn that true growth comes from the inside?
